Nasdaq faces major rout amid AI fears
Binance hackers target $6.3 billion crypto heist

articles.headline: Reliance Reports 41% Profit Jump on Refining Strength
articles.brief: Reliance Industries posted a 41% surge in quarterly profit, reaching ₹25,548 crore, driven by robust refining margins and strong performance from Jio Platforms. Revenue climbed 29%, cementing the conglomerate's powerhouse financial standing.

articles.headline: ISRO Launches GSLV-F18 Carrying NVS-03 Navigation Satellite
articles.brief: The Indian Space Research Organisation successfully placed the next-generation navigation satellite NVS-03 into orbit using the GSLV-F18 rocket. Equipped with an indigenous atomic clock, the 12-year mission aims to restore the NavIC regional constellation and boost military independence.

articles.headline: Nasdaq Faces $2 Trillion Wipeout Amid AI Spending Fears
articles.brief: Global tech stocks suffered a massive selloff, with the Nasdaq staring at a staggering $2 trillion wipeout for October. Deepening investor anxieties over runaway AI infrastructure spending and sliding hardware demand triggered widespread panic across Wall Street.

articles.headline: India Announces Schedule for Second Phase of Census 2027
articles.brief: The Ministry of Home Affairs notified the schedule for Census 2027, with self-enumeration slated to begin on January 10. The door-to-door population enumeration phase will run from January 25 to February 28, featuring an expanded questionnaire and a record 50-day timeline.

articles.headline: US Investigates Potential North Korean Link in Binance Heist
articles.brief: President Donald Trump stated that US authorities are actively investigating whether North Korean state-backed hackers orchestrated a massive $6.3 billion security breach targeting cryptocurrency exchange Binance, sending shockwaves through global digital asset markets.

articles.headline: India Orders Sun Pharma to Halt Eye-Care Drug Production
articles.brief: Indian regulators have ordered Sun Pharmaceutical Industries to halt the production of eye-care drugs at a key manufacturing facility following major quality control lapses discovered during inspections, dealing a blow to the pharmaceutical giant's compliance record.

articles.headline: Supreme Court Rules Consensual Relationship Regret Isn't Rape
articles.brief: The Supreme Court ruled that a failed or soured relationship cannot automatically convert consensual physical intimacy into rape. The bench carefully distinguished between consent obtained via deception and simple regret after a consensual affair ends.

articles.headline: China Deploys Stealth Attack Drone on Amphibious Ship
articles.brief: Beijing announced that its advanced stealth attack drone successfully completed its maiden takeoff and landing sequence aboard an amphibious assault ship, marking a significant milestone in naval aviation and power projection capabilities.

articles.headline: Poland Political Crisis Deepens as Top Court Chief Suspended
articles.brief: A major institutional clash erupted in Poland between the Prime Minister and the President after the chief of the top court was suspended. The judiciary branded the move an unconstitutional coup d'état as political instability grips Warsaw.

articles.headline: Glacial Lake Outburst Flood Wreaks Havoc in Bhutan
articles.brief: A sudden Glacial Lake Outburst Flood swept through parts of Bhutan, severely damaging critical road infrastructure and washing away a major bridge. Neighboring Assam districts have been placed on high alert as floodwaters progress downstream.

articles.headline: India's Diesel Exports Hit 13-Month High Amid Iran Conflict
articles.brief: India's diesel exports surged 19.6% month-on-month to hit a 13-month high in October. Domestic refiners capitalized heavily on global supply chain disruptions and elevated margins resulting from the ongoing Iran war and European energy crunches.

articles.headline: Cursor Reports Tampered Claude Code Extension Affects Users
articles.brief: AI code editor Cursor disclosed that up to 5,000 users were impacted by a compromised and tampered extension involving Claude Code. Developers have been urged to update their systems immediately as security audits continue.

articles.headline: DOJ Seeks Grand Jury Indictment Against James Comey
articles.brief: Federal prosecutors announced that the US Department of Justice is actively pursuing a grand jury indictment against former FBI Director James Comey, alleging he directed the unauthorized sharing of sensitive national defense secrets.

articles.headline: India Imposes Stricter Background Verification Rules for Jobs
articles.brief: The Uttar Pradesh government overhauled character verification regulations for state government jobs following recent Gen-Z protests. Candidates linked to violent organizations or specific criminal charges will now face strict legal bars from employment.

articles.headline: Competition Commission Clears Xavier Niel's Vodafone Stake Buy
articles.brief: India's Competition Commission has granted formal approval for French billionaire Xavier Niel to acquire a 16.2% stake in Vodafone, opening doors for expanded foreign investment and strategic repositioning within the Indian telecommunications market.
